categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: www and http both 301 to apex in one hop

findings.title: No robots.txt
findings.description: GET /robots.txt returns 404. The site has a large authenticated area consuming crawl budget via repeated 302s.

findings.title: /pricing/ is an orphan page
findings.description: The string href=/pricing/ appears 0 times across all 4 public pages. The repo confirms every pricing URL reference sits inside a login-gated template.
findings.recommendation: Add a pricing link to the public nav and footer in templates/base.html plus a pricing CTA on the homepage.

findings.title: Static assets cached for only 60 seconds
findings.description: Cache-Control: max-age=60, public. No STORAGES configured, so WhiteNoise runs without manifest hashing or pre-compression.

findings.title: No contact details, Terms or Privacy Policy
findings.description: Homepage scan found the legal name GEMILEADS IKE but no VAT, address, phone, email, Terms or Privacy link. The footer contains 0 links. The site charges 19 to 99 EUR per month.
findings.recommendation: Add /terms/, /privacy/, /contact/ and a real footer with company identity. Required for QRG trust, GDPR compliance, and Stripe.

findings.title: Thin content on primary pages
findings.recommendation: Expand the homepage to 800-1200 words explaining GEMI data, KAD filtering and update frequency.

findings.title: No informational content layer
findings.description: Only 4 public pages, no blog or guides. Zero topical authority around GEMI and KAD queries.
findings.recommendation: Validate demand first, then build an informational cluster. Enforce 60 percent unique content if generating per-KAD pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Unique descriptive titles within display limits

findings.title: No meta descriptions
findings.description: Absent on all 4 public pages. Google will synthesise snippets from a 321-word page.

findings.title: No canonical tags
findings.description: Absent site-wide. Lower risk given correct host redirects and no URL parameters in use.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips H1 to H4
findings.description: Homepage order is H1, H4, H4, H4, H4, H2. The four H4s are decorative preview-card labels appearing above the first H2.
findings.recommendation: Demote the card labels to non-heading elements in templates/home.html.

findings.title: No Schema.org markup of any kind
findings.description: JSON-LD occurrences across all public pages: 0. No entity definition exists for search or AI engines.
findings.recommendation: Add Organization and WebSite site-wide, plus SoftwareApplication with offers on /pricing/. Blocked by the missing contact data. Do not add FAQPage (retired 2026-05-07) or HowTo (deprecated 2023).

findings.title: Tailwind Play CDN in production
findings.description: 120.4 KB render-blocking JavaScript JIT compiler that generates CSS on the visitor device. Tailwind documents it as development-only.
findings.recommendation: Deploy 446a28f, which replaces it with a 7.7 KB gzipped compiled stylesheet. Verify the npm build step succeeds or the site ships unstyled.

findings.title: TTFB 0.8 to 1.3 seconds
findings.description: Measured across 3 runs. DNS and connect are under 30 ms, so the latency is server-side. An uncached Company count query runs in a context processor on every request.
findings.recommendation: Cache the global count for 3600 seconds, then investigate Render instance cold start for the remainder.

findings.title: Render-blocking Google Fonts
findings.description: Blocking third-party stylesheet requesting 5 font weights.
findings.recommendation: Self-host Inter as woff2 or reduce to the 2-3 weights actually used.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot and PerplexityBot all receive 200
Server-side rendering means no JS barrier for AI crawlers

findings.title: Low passage-level citability
findings.description: 321-word homepage, no definitional statements, no entity schema, and an H1 to H4 outline break degrading passage segmentation.
findings.recommendation: Write standalone definitional paragraphs under descriptive headings. This is a content problem, not a markup problem.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Zero img elements on public pages - all iconography is inline SVG, so no alt text, dimension or lazy-loading gaps exist

findings.title: favicon.png is 129 KB
findings.description: 132331 bytes at 353x353, rendered at 48x48. It is the largest single asset on the homepage critical path.
findings.recommendation: Deploy 446a28f, which resizes it to 128x128 at 22 KB.

findings.title: logo.png is 382 KB but currently unused
findings.description: 391443 bytes at 1255x347, referenced 0 times on the live homepage. It becomes relevant once used as og:image.
findings.recommendation: Deploy 446a28f, which reduces it to 105 KB.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Push and deploy commit 446a28f - closes 8 findings at once
Verify robots.txt 200, sitemap.xml 200, zero cdn.tailwindcss.com references, meta description present
Confirm the Render build log shows the Tailwind stylesheet step, or roll back
Link /pricing/ from the public nav and footer plus a homepage CTA
Add /terms/, /privacy/, /contact/ and a real footer with company identity

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Cache the site-wide company count in the context processor
Configure WhiteNoise manifest storage with 1-year immutable caching
Add Organization, WebSite and SoftwareApplication JSON-LD
Fix the H1 to H4 outline break on the homepage
Expand homepage and pricing copy to 800-1200 words

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Validate keyword demand in Search Console before writing anything
Build an informational cluster only if demand is confirmed
Enforce 60 percent unique content on any programmatic KAD pages

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Verify Search Console and submit the sitemap
Track indexed pages, pricing page impressions and CWV field data
Self-host Inter and trim unused font weights
